Campaign OS Full Brand Bible Workbook, Swing Shack section D+E

copy_system.sentence_length: Short to medium. One clear idea per sentence.
copy_system.humour: Witty and warm. Never at the golfer's expense. Never clownish.
copy_system.technical_depth: High when TrackMan or fitting data adds clarity. Plain language first.
copy_system.emoji_policy: Occasional and intentional. Never as a crutch or substitute for personality.
copy_system.punctuation: Sentence case headlines. Commas and colons over em dashes.
signature_lines: The ball speaks. Data confirms. Feel seals the deal.
Golf is more fun when it makes sense
The swing may lie, but the ball tells the truth.
The ball tells the truth. We just read it.
copy_system.master_message: Real golf indoors: coaching, fitting, and practice backed by TrackMan data.
supporting_messages: Fitting that starts with the player.
Membership that feels like a club, not a contract.
approved_headlines: TrackMan truth: your slice has a cause.
banned_phrases: take your game to the next level
